visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a light pink sports bra and white high-waisted leggings, stands in a brightly lit studio. She is positioned next to a silver dance pole, gripping it with her hands. The studio features a wood-paneled wall on the left and a white wall with a large gold logo on the right. (2) She initiates her pole dance routine, lifting her legs and spinning gracefully around the pole. She demonstrates high core strength and flexibility as she moves through various poses. The camera is positioned at a low angle, capturing her full body and the surrounding studio environment. (3) The dancer performs an inversion, hanging upside down from the pole using her legs for grip while extending her arms. She maintains smooth transitions between different levels of the pole. (4) She begins a controlled descent, rotating slowly down the length of the pole. Her movements are rhythmic and synchronized with the background melody. (5) She lands softly on the white mat-covered floor, coming to a standing position and finishing her performance. The studio lighting remains bright and consistent throughout.
